headline: OpenAI rolls out visual 'Intelligent UI' with GPT-6
summary: OpenAI is rolling out GPT-6 to all ChatGPT tiers alongside a new 'Intelligent UI' that adds interactive visuals like diagrams, charts and buttons to chatbot responses.

claims.statement: OpenAI is launching a new, more visual Intelligent UI for ChatGPT.

sources.quote: The New ChatGPT Is More Show Than Tell
ChatGPT is getting a lot more visual, with the launch of a new interface

claims.statement: The Intelligent UI update rolls out to all users alongside GPT-6.

sources.quote: rolling out to all users alongside GPT-6

claims.statement: GPT-6 is coming to all tiers of ChatGPT.

sources.quote: GPT-6 is coming to all tiers of ChatGPT
OpenAI is rolling out GPT-6 to ChatGPT, and it will come with the capability to build more visual responses.

claims.statement: The update lets ChatGPT combine text responses with diagrams, charts, forms and tappable buttons.

sources.quote: combine a text response with diagrams, charts, forms, tappable buttons, and more
